Definition: a family (mostly used collectively in the singular)
BiblicalUsage: The word is the little ones, the children too young to know good from evil. When the spies' fear kept Israel out of the land, God said their little ones should go in and possess it, and Joshua read the law before all Israel, with the women and the little ones standing there.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God never counts the little ones as nothing: they were the ones who entered the land their parents refused.
